headline: Network18 Media discloses substantial acquisition in Infomedia Press Limited under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Network18 Media & Investments Limited filed a SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Infomedia Press Limited, triggering mandatory takeover regulatory requirements.
detail: Network18 Media & Investments Limited submitted a formal disclosure to the National Stock Exchange under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a substantial stake acquisition in Infomedia Press Limited. The disclosure triggers the mandatory takeover notice and public announcement framework. This is a regulatory milestone in a proposed acquisition of the media and publishing company.
